provenance.source: CNC-MACHINE-COST-BASIS-1 sprint; inputs carried from generic shop true-runtime-rate defaults, electricity derived from machine profile connected load. No owner-confirmation artifact exists yet for burden or tooling.

notes: Machine burden ($19.00/hr) is an inherited shop default at draft confidence: it is the generic shop burden number, NOT confirmed against this machine's annual depreciation/maintenance/insurance/overhead. Promote to owner_confirmed only when a supporting artifact exists.
Tooling ($8.00/hr) is an inherited shop default at draft confidence: the generic shop consumable wear allowance, not machine-specific evidence.

Electricity cost/hour is an engineering estimate: 24.0 kW connected load x load_factor 0.684 x $0.12/kWh = $1.97/hr. Load factor and price are documented assumptions chosen to reproduce the shop's existing $1.97/hr electricity figure; they are not metered values.
machine_hour_rate ($28.97/hr) is a true-cost rate: burden 19.00 + electricity 1.97 + tooling 8.00. It is a COST input, not a customer billing rate and not margin-inclusive.
Record status is 'draft' because its burden and tooling inputs are unconfirmed inherited defaults.
connected_load_kw (24.0) mirrors MACHINE-BCM2030CA-ATC-V1 connected_load_estimate.total_kw; changing the profile's total_kw should be reflected here.
